drivers.name: BirdDog PTZ Camera
drivers.author: OpenAVC
drivers.description: Controls BirdDog PTZ cameras via REST API and VISCA. Pan, tilt, zoom, focus, presets, exposure, white balance, tally, and NDI encode settings.

help.overview:
Controls any BirdDog PTZ camera — P100, P200, P240, P400, A200, A300, X1, MAKI, and newer models. Uses the built-in REST API for configuration and VISCA-over-UDP for real-time PTZ movement.

No external software, SDK, or runtime required.
help.setup:
1. Enter the camera's IP address (find it via the camera's on-screen display or BirdDog Central).
2. Default REST port is 8080, VISCA port is 52381.
3. No authentication is required.
4. Use 'recall_preset' and 'save_preset' with preset numbers (1-255 depending on model).
